about_short_description.short_description: Marketplace, AI, Lending, Investments, Financing, Artificial Intelligence

product.name: Working Capital Financing
product.description: Provides business financing up to SAR 5 million for 1 to 36 months with fixed or lump sum payments to support cash flow needs, compliant with Shariah law.

product.name: Invoice Finance
product.description: Offers cash financing against accounts receivable invoices covering up to 80% of invoice value for 1 to 12 months, with simple procedures and Shariah compliance.

product.name: Point of Sale (POS) Financing
product.description: Provides short-term financing up to SAR 500,000 secured by products purchased for resale, with flexible installments and Shariah compliance for 1 to 12 months.

product.name: Forus Risk Score
product.description: A credit risk assessment tool that evaluates investment opportunities using financial and operational metrics, providing a risk rating from A (low risk) to G (high risk).

product.name: Debt Crowdfunding Platform
product.description: An online platform connecting investors with SMEs seeking Shariah-compliant business financing through alternative debt instruments.

identifier.value: Business Loan Application and Management Platform

product.name: Business Loan Application and Management Platform
product.description: A digital platform for SMEs to apply for, manage, and receive decisions on Shariah-compliant business financing with streamlined documentation and fast approval.
